description: This file is a C header file defining the interface for a JSON request handler in a Host Interface module. It declares functions related to HTTP server control, JSON message handling, and request parsing for a TR-069 device management protocol implementation.

methods.name: hostIf_HttpServerStart
methods.description: Starts the HTTP server to listen for incoming JSON requests.

methods.name: hostIf_HTTPJsonMsgHandler
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON messages from HTTP clients and processes them.

methods.name: hostIf_HttpServerStop
methods.description: Stops the HTTP server handling JSON requests.
